name: claude-limit-break
description: Watches Claude Code transcripts for usage limits and resumes your session automatically.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Resuming a session launches the Claude CLI in the workspace folder.

commands.title: Limit Break: Open Claude to Trust

claudeLimitBreak.enabled.description: Watch Claude Code transcripts for usage limits and server errors.

claudeLimitBreak.autoResume.description: Resume automatically when the cooldown elapses. When off, a notification offers a Resume Now action instead, and the job stays resumable from the "Limit Break: Resume Now" command until you use it.

enumDescriptions: Open a new terminal running Claude at your normal autonomy level.
Run Claude in the background with -p. Requires an explicit permission mode below, or tool calls are denied.
claudeLimitBreak.resumeMode.markdownDescription: `interactive` opens a new terminal running Claude at your normal autonomy level. `headless` runs it with `-p` and needs an explicit permission mode to do any tool work. Machine-scoped: a workspace cannot change how the extension launches Claude.

enumDescriptions: No permission mode is passed. Tool calls are denied.
Let Claude plan without making changes.
claudeLimitBreak.headlessPermissionMode.markdownDescription: Permission mode passed to headless resumes. Empty means none, so tool calls are denied. Machine-scoped: a workspace must not be able to grant autonomy.

claudeLimitBreak.claudeCommand.markdownDescription: Path to the `claude` executable. Empty auto-detects from PATH. Machine-scoped: this names the program that gets run.

claudeLimitBreak.resumePrompt.default: [Limit Break] I hit my usage limit while you were working, but it has reset now. Please continue from where you left off.
claudeLimitBreak.resumePrompt.description: Prompt sent when resuming. Passed as a single argument, never through a shell. Machine-scoped: this is the instruction a tool-using agent acts on, so a workspace must not be able to set it.

claudeLimitBreak.maxResumeTokens.markdownDescription: Refuse to resume when the estimated cost exceeds this, and offer a "Resume anyway" button rather than dropping it. The estimate reads the transcript's newest `usage` record - the live context a cold resume has to rebuild - and falls back to a byte count only when there is none. Set to `0` to never refuse.

claudeLimitBreak.maxWaitHours.description: Ignore a reset time further out than this, which is usually a misparse.

claudeLimitBreak.transcriptPollSeconds.description: Polling backstop interval, for when recursive file watching is unreliable.

claudeLimitBreak.randomDelayMinMinutes.description: Minimum random padding added after a reset time.

claudeLimitBreak.randomDelayMaxMinutes.description: Maximum random padding added after a reset time.

claudeLimitBreak.notify.description: Show a notification when a limit is detected and when a resume fires.

claudeLimitBreak.alertSound.description: Chime when a Claude turn finishes in a folder open in this window.

claudeLimitBreak.alertSoundFile.markdownDescription: Sound file to play. Empty uses the system default. Machine-scoped: the path reaches a media player.

enumDescriptions: Show a notification with a button to reopen the tab.
Close and reopen the tab automatically.
claudeLimitBreak.onStale.markdownDescription: What to do when a resumed session is still open in a Claude Code panel tab. That tab holds its own idea of where the conversation ends, so typing into it starts a branch that drops the resumed turn ([#6](https://github.com/Dream-Mosaic/claude-limit-break/issues/6)). Reopening the tab clears it.

enumDescriptions: Show a marker while watching, and the countdown when a resume is pending.
Show the countdown, the ready pill and the gave-up marker; nothing while merely watching with none of those pending.
Never show a status bar item.
claudeLimitBreak.statusBar.markdownDescription: When to show the status bar item. `always` keeps a small marker visible while watching, so a window with the extension running does not look identical to one where it failed to load.

enumDescriptions: React to every Claude session on this machine.
React only to sessions whose folder is inside this window's workspace.
claudeLimitBreak.watchScope.markdownDescription: Which sessions to watch. `machine` also catches a session started in a plain terminal in a project no window has open, which is the case the global watcher exists for; `workspace` is cheaper and stops two open windows both reacting to the same limit.

claudeLimitBreak.checkForUpdates.markdownDescription: Check GitHub once a day for a newer release and say so. Off by default because it is an outbound request to `api.github.com`; a VSIX never updates itself, so nothing else will tell you. Failures are silent.
